title: Social Determinants of Health in Hepatobiliary Cancer Patients
official: Social Determinants of Health in Hepatobiliary Cancer Patients
summary: This study evaluates barriers to receiving care and risks associated with developing cancer among patients diagnosed with hepatobiliary cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients 18+ year of age with hepatobiliary cancers

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under 18 years of age
